summary: AIOS Tech Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice and proxy statement for an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) scheduled for May 29, 2026. The EGM seeks shareholder approval to increase the voting power of Class B shares from 5 to 100 votes per share and adopt amended articles of association. The board unanimously recommends a vote FOR. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation is involved; it is a routine governance and capital structure proposal typical of a foreign private issuer.
